newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon court dismisses Saudi prince lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon court dismisses Saudi prince lawsuit.

text.p: A commercial Lebanese court dismissed a lawsuit filed by Saudi Prince Walid bin Talal against the owners of one of Lebanon's biggest publication houses, judicial sources said on Wednesday.
The prince had accused the Freiha family, owners of Dar as-Sayyad International of breaching an agreement to sell 50 percent of the house to his Lebanese mother, Princess Mona al-Solh.
The sources said a Mount Lebanon commercial court dismissed the case as unlawful on March 6.
Prince Talal, a billionaire businessman, had already paid 50 percent of the sales price to the Freiha family but it was refunded by the Freihas, the prince's lawyers said earlier.
Prince Talal will appeal against the ruling at a higher court, one of the lawyers said on Wednesday.
Dar as-Sayyad issues 12 daily, weekly and monthly political and cultural newspapers and magazines.
